details:
It would be nice to have an alternative to the default robot when hiding a user’s avatar. 

A common example: someone is scaled up, has giant wings blocking the view of others, or simply has a disruptive avatar. Our current tools to solve this are to hide their avatar or block the user. Both fail to adequately address the issue.

Hiding them replaces their avatar with a robot, but they are still a giant obstructing vision or clipping into others. The robot is also aesthetically out of place in many settings, like clubs, event recording, gatherings of a common interest, etc.

Blocking the user is an aggressive solution, which creates more problems than solves. While hidden, they also may be sitting on your head with neither knowing. This can cause social friction, turning an impersonal act into a personal one.

Solution: An option to manually turn a user’s avatar into a transparent diamond as we see during load or out of culling range. Such would alert a user of the other’s presence, while minimizing the obstruction and reducing the friction of someone getting in their space. 

In our quick menu, we currently have:

Hide, Show, and Safety Settings.

I would like to have:

1.) Force fallback - (defaulting to mimic-fallback-robot)

2.) Hide - Transparent diamond instead of a robot (could add custom settings in future)

3.) Show - Bring the bling

4.) Safety settings - (Could be a toggle with options 3)

I think these are realistic changes using existing systems that would grant users greater control over their virtual experience while promoting a positive social atmosphere by reducing friction.
title: User Avatar Display Management Improvement
